text: Theorem 1 . ( [ 4 , Theorems 6.60 and 6.39 ] ) Let $g:\mathcal{E}\to(-\infty,+\infty]$ be a proper closed convex function and $\lambda>0$ . Then, for any $x\in\mathcal{E}$ , $\nabla M_{\lambda g}(x)=\frac{1}{\lambda}(x-\mathrm{prox}_{\lambda g}(x))=\mathrm{prox}_{g^{*}/\lambda}\left(\frac{x}{\lambda}\right)\in\partial g(\mathrm{prox}_{\lambda g}(x)),$ where $\partial g$ is the subdifferential of $g$ .

Theorem 2 . ( [ 4 , Theorem 4.23] ) Let $g:\mathcal{E}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a convex function. Then, $g$ is $L$ -Lipschitz continuous (i.e., $|g(x)-g(x^{\prime})|\leq L\|x-x^{\prime}\|$ for all $x,x^{\prime}\in\mathcal{E}$ ) if and only if $\mathrm{sup}_{y\in\mathrm{dom}\,g^{*}}\|y\|\leq L$ .

Definition 10 . Given $\epsilon>0$ , the point $x\in\mathcal{M}$ is an $\epsilon$ -Riemannian-stochastic-stationary ( $\epsilon$ -RSS) point of problem ( 1.1 ) if there exists a point $p\in\mathcal{E}_{2}$ such that $\max\!\left\{\mathbb{E}\left[\mathrm{dist}\left(0,\,\mathrm{grad}\,f(x)+\mathrm{proj}_{\mathrm{T}_{x}\mathcal{M}}\left(\nabla\mathcal{A}(x)^{\top}\partial h(p)\right)\right)\right],\,\mathbb{E}[\left\|p-\mathcal{A}(x)\right\|]\right\}\leq\epsilon,$ where the expectation $\mathbb{E}[\cdot]$ is taken over all randomness in the course of generating $x$ .

Theorem 11 . Suppose that Assumptions 4.1 , 4.2 , and 4.3 hold. Given $\epsilon>0$ , let $\{x_{k}\}$ be the sequence generated by Algorithm 1 . Then, Algorithm 1 returns an $\epsilon$ -RSS point of problem ( 1.1 ) in at most ${\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-3})$ iterations while making at most ${\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-3})$ SFO calls.
